messages.text: What is OFDM, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

The RAW passages supplied do not state an OFDM definition or R&S measurement-option details; they only show an image placeholder, a brochure pointer, and contact metadata [65][66][67][68].
OFDM is a waveform in which many QAM symbols are linearly combined by an IFFT, producing signals with high peak-to-average power ratio, or PAPR [2].  
In an OFDM system, each time-domain OFDM symbol has a cyclic prefix added as a guard interval to reduce inter-symbol interference [19].  
In NR, the resource grid combines time-domain OFDM symbols with frequency-domain subcarriers, and one resource element is one subcarrier in one OFDM symbol on one antenna port [18].  
R&S CMW100 WLAN bandwidth decisions depend on OFDM because its WLAN OFDM RF analyzer bandwidths vary by standard from 5 MHz / 10 MHz / 20 MHz up to 20 MHz / 40 MHz / 80 MHz / 80+80 MHz / 160 MHz [10].  
R&S CMW100 MIMO measurement decisions depend on OFDM because WLAN OFDM MIMO options include composite MIMO R&S®CMW-KM652 and switched MIMO R&S®CMW-KM653, with WLAN OFDM RF analyzer MIMO up to 8 × 8 [10].  
R&S satellite-payload test decisions depend on OFDM because the cited R&S application context includes OFDM signal generation and analysis for custom OFDM, DFT-s-OFDM, f-OFDM, UFMC, FBMC, and GFDM [63].  
R&S SMW200A decisions depend on OFDM because the product is listed for OFDM waveform generation, multi-carrier/modulated signal generation, DPD, and NPR stimulus [49].  
R&S SMW200A bandwidth decisions depend on OFDM because the same passage lists up to 2 GHz I/Q modulation bandwidth and up to 4 GHz signal bandwidth with R&S SMW-K555 [49].  
R&S FSW-related analysis decisions depend on OFDM in this satellite-payload context because R&S FSW is listed for signal quality measurements including spurious, carrier-in-carrier, oscillator/synthesizer, group delay, linearity, NPR, and signal quality measurements, while the same source set includes OFDM among the satellite payload test concepts [49].  
R&S SMBV100B option decisions depend on OFDM because R&S®SMBVB-K811 Notched signals is supported with ARB, LTE, cellular IoT, and custom OFDM [62].  
NR measurement-configuration decisions depend on OFDM understanding because normal cyclic prefix uses 14 OFDM symbols per slot and extended cyclic prefix uses 12 OFDM symbols per slot [17].  
NR numerology decisions depend on OFDM understanding because numerology μ defines time-frequency resolution and determines OFDM symbol duration and subcarrier spacing [26].  
PTRS configuration decisions depend on OFDM understanding because the cited PT-RS density chapter applies to PDSCH and PUSCH in normal OFDM with transform precoding disabled [36].

answer.question: What is OFDM, and which Rohde & Schwarz product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it? Include citations to Raw evidence.

passages.text:
Low-PAPR sequence › Transform precoding 與 π/2-BPSK
依 [[DMRS]]：

- [[DFT-s-OFDM]] 也稱為 [[Transform precoding]]，在 LTE 與 NR 的 UL 中啟用，用於取得 low-PAPR UL transmit signal。
- Transform precoding 中 modulation symbols 先經 DFT-precoded，再輸入 OFDM modulator。
- DFT 與 OFDM modulator 的 IFFT block effectively cancels one another，因此移除 OFDM modulator 的 high-PAPR effect。
- 使用 low-PAPR modulation symbols 可進一步降低 UL transmit signal 的 PAPR。
- NR 中 UL transmission with transform precoding 啟用 [[π-2-BPSK]] modulation。
- [[π-2-BPSK]] 產生 low-PAPR waveform，因為 symbol-to-symbol transition 不會穿越 constellation 的 zero-amplitude point。

Low-PAPR sequence › 背景：為什麼需要 low-PAPR
依 [[DMRS]]：

- OFDM signals 具有 high peak-to-average power ratio（PAPR），因為由 many random QAM symbols 的 linear combination（IFFT）形成。
- High-PAPR signal 需要 transmitter back-off power amplifier operating point，以避免 transmit signal 進入 power amplifier saturation region 而 clipped / distorted。
- Power amplifier 遠離 saturation point 操作時 efficiency drops。
- DL signals 由連接 power grid 的 base station 傳送，因此 high-PAPR 在 DL 不 critical；NR uses OFDM for DL signals。
- NR 與 LTE 不同，NR UL 也允許使用 OFDM signals。
- UL 可能需要 low-PAPR signal，使 [[UE]] power amplifier 更接近 saturation point 並提升 efficiency，降低 UE battery energy 消耗。

Low-PAPR sequence › Type 1（Release 15）
依 [[DMRS]]：

- [[Low-PAPR sequence Type 1]] 屬 [[Release 15]]。
- 使用 [[Zadoff-Chu sequence]] 或 computer-generated sequences；reference：[[3GPP TS 38.211]] Section 5.2.2。
- 用於 transform precoding enabled 時的 PUSCH DMRS sequences，且 Type 2 的條件不成立時。
- 也用於 PUCCH format 1 的 DMRS sequences，以及 PUCCH formats 3 and 4 的 DMRS sequences。
- Small sequences：1 to 5 PRBs，使用 computer-generated 或 Zadoff-Chu sequences。
- Large sequence：more than 5 PRBs，使用 Zadoff-Chu sequences。
- Zadoff-Chu sequences based on length `N_ZC_RS`，其中 `N_ZC_RS` 是小於 `M_ZC_RS` 的最大 prime number。
- 第 `N_ZC_RS` 個 sample 之後，sequence 從 beginning repeat。
- Sequences depend on group number only，not on `n_ID`。

Low-PAPR sequence › Type 2（Release 16）
依 [[DMRS]]：

- [[Low-PAPR sequence Type 2]] 屬 [[Release 16]]。
- [[3GPP TS 38.211]] Section 5.2.3 定義新的 low-PAPR sequences：`low-PAPR Type 2`。
- Type 2 使用 pseudo-noise 或 computer-generated sequences。
- `n_ID` is not effective。
- 用於 transform precoding enabled 時的 PUSCH DMRS sequences，且以下條件全部成立：
  - PUSCH modulated with [[π-2-BPSK]]。
  - PUSCH transmission is not a `msg3` transmission。
  - Scheduling is not using `DCI format 0_0` in a common search space。
- Type 2 low-PAPR sequence generated from the DFT of the [[π-2-BPSK]] modulated computer generated sequences（CGS）or gold sequences。
- DFT operation may cause some sequence samples to be zero，因此 channel estimation 需要 special handling。
- Small sequences：1 to 4 PRBs，使用 computer-generated sequences。
- 有些 sequences 由 [[3GPP TS 38.211]] Tables 5.2.3.2-2 to 5.2.3.2-4 定義的 computer-generated binary sequences，並以 [[π-2-BPSK]] modulated。
- Sequences depend on sequence length and group number only，not on `n_ID`。

PRS collision priority › Current understanding
依 [[PRS (NR)]] 的 Current Understanding：

- PRS is not allowed to overlap with SSB OFDM symbols。
- PDCCH / PDSCH is not PRS aware, i.e. PDCCH / PDSCH rate-matching is not affected by PRS。
- If PRS collides with PDCCH / PDSCH then PRS has higher priority and PDCCH / PDSCH will be punctured。
- PDCCH / PDSCH transmission will probably be corrupted。
- In general, PRS overlap with other signals / channels does not really make sense because collision with other RS or DMRS is very likely, unless spatial separation on different beams is wanted。

PRS collision priority › 使用限制
- 本頁整理的是 [[PRS (NR)]] 的內部筆記與 customer test case requirements，不是 formal priority table。
- 不可把本頁用於 conformance decision、scheduler implementation 或 product support commitment。
- 若需落實實作，必須回 [[3GPP TS 38.211]]、[[3GPP TS 38.214]]、[[3GPP TS 37.355]] 與 R&S 產品需求文件裁決。

PRS collision priority › 明確矛盾
⚠️ [[PRS (NR)]]（來源未標示正式日期）在 Current Understanding 說 If PRS collides with PDCCH/PDSCH then PRS has higher priority and PDCCH/PDSCH will be punctured，但同一來源的 Customer Test Case Requirements 說 PDCCH has higher priority than PRS，且 RA-RNTI / SI-RNTI PDSCH higher priority than PRS。判斷：來源內部將 general understanding 與 customer-specific requirements 並列但未裁決；目前應標為未決，不可用單一句子建立產品或標準規則。

PRS collision priority › 可能的解讀邊界
以下是整理，不是裁決：

- Current Understanding 可能是一般假設：PDCCH / PDSCH not PRS aware，因此碰撞時 PRS punctures PDCCH / PDSCH。
- Customer Test Case Requirements 可能是測試需求優先序：特定 RNTI / channel / RS 有 higher priority。
- 因來源未給正式 standard references 或 requirement IDs，不可判斷哪一段較新或較權威。

R&S CMW100 K06 › 規格資料的使用限制
[[CMW100-K06_specs_en_5214-8348-22_v0500]] 對規格類型定義如下：

- Specifications with limits 代表 warranted product performance，以 `<`、`≤`、`>`、`≥`、`±`、maximum、minimum 等標示。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits 標示為 n. trc.，因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，產品性能不保證。
- Specifications without limits 代表指定參數的 warranted product performance，通常為 dimensions 或 setting parameter resolution 等無偏差或偏差可忽略的值。
- Typical data 標示為 typ.，若標示為 `<`、`>` 或 range，代表生產時約 80% instruments 可達到的 performance；否則代表 mean value。
- Nominal values 標示為 nom.，不進行 statistical evaluation，生產時不測試該參數。
- Measured values 標示為 meas.，以個別 samples 的 measurement results 描述 expected product performance。
- Uncertainties 以 coverage factor 2 定義，依 GUM 規則計算，納入 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 保證。
- Data without tolerance limits is not binding；Subject to change。

R&S CMW100 K06 › WLAN
- WLAN RF generator standards 與 options：IEEE 802.11a/g/p/n OFDM、IEEE 802.11b/g DSSS 使用 R&S®CMW-KW650；IEEE 802.11ac 使用 R&S®CMW-KW656；IEEE 802.11ax 使用 R&S®CMW-KW657。
- WLAN generator bandwidth：up to 160 MHz。
- WLAN generator frequency range：2.4 GHz band 2412 MHz to 2484 MHz；5 GHz band 5000 MHz to 6000 MHz，prerequisite R&S®CMW-K046 option。
- WLAN OFDM RF analyzer options：IEEE 802.11a/g R&S®CMW-KM650；IEEE 802.11n R&S®CMW-KM651；IEEE 802.11p R&S®CMW-KM655；IEEE 802.11ac R&S®CMW-KM656；IEEE 802.11ax R&S®CMW-KM657。
- WLAN OFDM MIMO：composite MIMO R&S®CMW-KM652；switched MIMO R&S®CMW-KM653。
- WLAN OFDM RF analyzer bandwidth：802.11a/g 20 MHz；802.11n 20 MHz / 40 MHz；802.11p 5 MHz / 10 MHz / 20 MHz；802.11ac/ax 20 MHz / 40 MHz / 80 MHz / 80+80 MHz / 160 MHz。
- WLAN OFDM RF analyzer MIMO：switched 與 composite，最高 8 × 8。

5G NR frame structure › OFDM symbols per slot
依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- [[Normal CP]] 使用 14 [[OFDM symbol]]s per slot。
- [[Extended CP]] 使用 12 [[OFDM symbol]]s per slot。
- 來源明示在 NR Release 15 中，[[Extended CP]] only defined for numerology μ=2。

5G NR frame structure › 與 resource grid 的關係
Frame / subframe / slot / symbol 是 time-domain structure；[[NR resource grid]] 則把 time-domain [[OFDM symbol]] 與 frequency-domain subcarriers 組成 grid。

- [[Resource Element]] 是 one subcarrier in one OFDM symbol and on one antenna port。
- [[Resource Block]] 是 12 consecutive subcarriers。
- [[Point-A]] 是 resource grid starts toward higher frequencies 的 frequency-domain reference。

NR cyclic prefix › 基本概念
依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- 在 OFDM system 中，CP is added for each OFDM symbol in time-domain。
- CP 是把 raw OFDM symbol 最後幾個 samples 複製到 raw OFDM symbol 前方。
- CP provides a guard interval between two OFDM symbols。
- CP 用於 eliminate inter-symbol interference, ISI。
- NR defines two types of cyclic prefix lengths：[[Normal CP]] 與 [[Extended CP]]。

NR cyclic prefix › Normal CP
[[Normal CP]] 是 normal short length CP：

- 用於 short delay spread environment。
- 14 [[OFDM symbol]]s per slot。
- 來源說 standard CP length of most OFDM symbols is 9/128 × NFFT，approximately 7 percent redundancy overhead。
- CP of the first OFDM symbol of every half-subframe is longer than all others，以 compensate inequality。

來源列出的 NCP 標準 CP duration：

| μ | Raw OFDM symbol duration | Standard CP duration | Long CP duration | Delay spread estimate |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 0 | 66.667 μs | 4.6875 μs | 5.2083 μs | 1406 m |
| 1 | 33.333 μs | 2.3438 μs | 2.8646 μs | 703 m |
| 2 | 16.667 μs | 1.1719 μs | 1.6927 μs | 351.6 m |
| 3 | 8.333 μs | 0.5859 μs | 1.1067 μs | 175.8 m |
| 4 | 4.167 μs | 0.2930 μs | 0.8138 μs | 87.9 m |

NR cyclic prefix › Extended CP
[[Extended CP]] 是 extended longer length CP：

- 用於 long delay spread environment。
- 12 [[OFDM symbol]]s per slot。
- CP length is same for all OFDM symbols。
- CP length = NFFT / 4。
- 來源說 this means 25 percent redundancy overhead。
- 來源明示：In NR Release 15 the ECP is only defined for numerology μ=2。

來源列出的 ECP CP duration 線索：

| μ | Raw OFDM symbol duration | CP duration | OFDM symbol incl. CP | Slot duration | Delay spread estimate |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 0 | 66.667 μs | 16.667 μs | 83.333 μs | 1000 μs | 5000 m |
| 1 | 33.333 μs | 8.333 μs | 41.667 μs | 500 μs | 2500 m |
| 2 | 16.667 μs | 4.167 μs | 20.833 μs | 250 μs | 1250 m |
| 3 | 8.333 μs | 2.083 μs | 10.417 μs | 125 μs | 625 m |
| 4 | 4.167 μs | 1.042 μs | 5.208 μs | 62.5 μs | 312.5 m |

注意：雖然來源表中列出多個 μ 的 ECP duration，來源同頁明示 NR Release 15 ECP only defined for μ=2；因此不可把表格直接解讀為所有 μ 在 Release 15 均可用。

NR cyclic prefix › 與 samples per slot 的關係
依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- Samples per subframe S = NFFT × 15 × 2^μ。
- Samples per slot = samples per subframe / slots per subframe = NFFT × 15。
- Useful samples per slot = NFFT × 14 useful OFDM samples。
- CP 對應的 redundant samples distributed over subframe。

當 14 OFDM symbols per slot 時：

- Redundant samples per subframe = NFFT × 2^μ。
- Each slot has total NFFT redundant samples。

當 12 OFDM symbols per slot 時：

- Redundant samples per subframe = 3 × NFFT × 2^μ。
- Each slot has total 3 × NFFT redundant samples。

NR cyclic prefix
[[NR cyclic prefix]] 是 5G NR OFDM symbol 前方加上的 guard interval；[[NR Frame Structure]] 將其分為 [[Normal CP]] 與 [[Extended CP]]。

5G NR numerology › 與 cyclic prefix 的關係
[[NR cyclic prefix]] 的來源表格列出：

- [[Normal CP]]：μ=0、1、2、3、4 皆列於來源表格，使用 14 OFDM symbols per slot。
- [[Extended CP]]：來源明示 NR Release 15 only defined for μ=2，使用 12 OFDM symbols per slot。

5G NR numerology
[[5G NR numerology]] 是 5G NR 中以 μ 表示的 OFDM time-frequency resolution 參數，決定 [[Subcarrier Spacing]]、slot duration、subframe 中 slots 數量，以及 [[SSB]] required bandwidth。

5G NR numerology › 定義
依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- Numerology μ defines the time-frequency resolution。
- μ 決定 [[OFDM symbol]] time duration 與 [[Subcarrier Spacing]]。
- NR reference SCS μ=0 是 15 kHz，來源說與 LTE 相同。
- μ 越高，time resolution 越高。
- μ 越高，frequency resolution 越低。

PTRS time and frequency density › Default values 與 short allocations
依 [[PT-RS (NR)]]：

- Provided MCS / resource block threshold lists may be empty。
- In this case default values are defined in [[3GPP TS 38.214]] chapters 5.1.6.3 / 6.2.3.1。
- Downlink-only case：if neither time nor frequency threshold lists are provided by RRC, PTRS shall not be present under several conditions related to MCS tables 5.1.3.1-1、5.1.3.1-2、5.1.3.1-3；但 exact values / inequalities 被 raw 轉檔遺失。
- For both uplink or downlink, TS 38.214 says PTRS shall moreover not be present in case a special short allocation condition holds；但 exact condition 被 raw 轉檔遺失。

PTRS time and frequency density › Normal OFDM density derivation
依 [[PT-RS (NR)]]，本段 applies to PTRS configuration of [[PDSCH]] and [[PUSCH]] in case of normal OFDM：

- `transform precoding disabled`。
- PUSCH with transform precoding configuration will be added later；來源未提供。
- Higher layers do not specify time / frequency density directly for every PUSCH / PDSCH allocation。
- Instead, RRC provides a list of MCS thresholds and a list of resource block thresholds。
- Resulting time and frequency densities are derived for every allocation。

PTRS time and frequency density
[[PTRS time and frequency density]] 描述 [[Phase-Tracking Reference Signal (NR)]] 在 selected subcarriers / REs 上的 time-domain 與 frequency-domain placement density；[[PT-RS (NR)]] 只提供 normal OFDM（transform precoding disabled）下的 PDSCH / PUSCH 配置線索。

PTRS time and frequency density › timeDensity
依 [[PT-RS (NR)]]：

- `timeDensity` defines the maximum distance of PT-RS REs on a PT-RS subcarrier。
- Valid values are 1, 2 or 4 [[OFDM symbol]]s。
- [[Demodulation Reference Signals (DMRS)]] REs count as PT-RS REs。
- Primarily already mapped DMRS REs are considered。
- Additional PT-RS REs are only mapped if the distance between two DMRS is larger than the configured maximum。

PTRS time and frequency density › frequencyDensity
依 [[PT-RS (NR)]]：

- `frequencyDensity` defines the distance of PT-RS subcarriers in number of [[Resource Block]]s。
- Valid values are 2 or 4 RBs。
- The RB offset relative to the allocation start depends on `frequencyDensity`、allocation size，以及一個 raw 轉檔遺失的參數。

PTRS time and frequency density › resourceElementOffset
依 [[PT-RS (NR)]]：

- `resourceElementOffset` configures four different frequency offsets relative to first [[Resource Element]] of a RB。
- 可配置 values：`offset00`、`offset01`、`offset10`、`offset11`。
- Final physical RE offset also depends on the associated antenna port and is derived from a look-up table。
- 該 look-up table 未在 raw markdown 中保留。

PTRS time and frequency density › MCS threshold 與 time density
來源引用 [[3GPP TS 38.214]] Tables 5.1.6.3-1 / 6.2.3.1-1，說 time density is derived from an MCS index of the PUSCH / PDSCH allocation。

Raw 轉檔可辨識 resulting PTRS time density values：

| Resulting PTRS time density | 備註 |
|---:|---|
| PTRS not present | threshold 條件遺失。 |
| 4 | threshold 條件遺失。 |
| 2 | threshold 條件遺失。 |
| 1 | threshold 條件遺失。 |

來源另說某個參數 is defined as the highest possible index of the used MCS table + 1；但該參數名稱在 raw 中缺失。For retransmissions，來源說 initial transmission 的某個值 is used for derivation of time density；但變數名稱也遺失。

PTRS time and frequency density › RB threshold 與 frequency density
來源引用 [[3GPP TS 38.214]] Tables 5.1.6.3-2 / 6.2.3.1-2，說 frequency density is derived from bandwidth of PUSCH / PDSCH allocation in number of resource blocks。

Raw 轉檔可辨識 resulting PTRS frequency density values：

| Resulting PTRS frequency density | 備註 |
|---:|---|
| PTRS not present | RB threshold 條件遺失。 |
| 2 | RB threshold 條件遺失。 |
| 4 | RB threshold 條件遺失。 |

Phase-Tracking Reference Signal (NR) › 使用限制
- [[PT-RS (NR)]] 未標示正式日期、版本或 3GPP release。
- 來源是 Rohde & Schwarz company confidential 技術筆記，不是 3GPP 正式標準全文。
- 來源引用 [[3GPP TS 38.211]]、[[3GPP TS 38.214]] 與 [[3GPP TS 38.212]] sections / tables，但未標示標準版本。
- 不能從本頁推論所有 PT-RS mapping、power scaling、threshold list 或 conformance requirement 的正式規則。

Phase-Tracking Reference Signal (NR) › Normal OFDM 限制
[[PT-RS (NR)]] 的 density configuration chapter 明示適用範圍：

- Applies to PTRS configuration of [[PDSCH]] and [[PUSCH]] in case of normal OFDM。
- `transform precoding disabled`。
- PUSCH with transform precoding 的 configuration will be added later；來源未提供內容。

Phase-Tracking Reference Signal (NR) › Time density、frequency density 與 RE offset
依 [[PT-RS (NR)]]，PT-RS 的時頻配置由 [[PTRS time and frequency density]] 描述：

- `timeDensity`：PT-RS REs on a PT-RS subcarrier 的 maximum distance；valid values 為 1、2、4 [[OFDM symbol]]s。
- `frequencyDensity`：PT-RS subcarriers 的 distance，以 RB 數計；valid values 為 2 或 4 [[Resource Block]]s。
- `resourceElementOffset`：提供 offset00、offset01、offset10、offset11 四種 frequency offsets relative to first RE of a RB；final physical RE offset also depends on associated antenna port and a look-up table。

Transform precoding › 使用限制
- [[PUSCH (NR)]] 沒有提供 transform precoding 的完整數學定義或 DFT-s-OFDM / CP-OFDM 正式描述。
- 本頁只保存目前來源中的 PUSCH / DMRS combination restrictions。

PUSCH resource allocation type 0 › 與 FR2 / PTRS 的未決判讀
依 [[PUSCH (NR)]] remark `*2`：

- 來源引用 [[3GPP TS 38.214]] Section 6.1.2.2.1：In frequency range 2, non-contiguous allocation per component carrier for UL RB allocation for [[CP-OFDM]] is not supported。
- 來源作者判讀：RA0 is not really possible in [[NR FR2]]。
- 因 [[Uplink PT-RS]] mainly a [[NR FR2]] feature，RA0 + PTRS combination so far had no clear focus。
- 來源作者同時說此組合看起來未被 explicitly excluded，且有 certain customer interest。

此段是技術筆記的推論性說法，不可寫成 3GPP 正式允許或正式禁止。

PUSCH feature combination table › RA0、FR2 與 PTRS
依 [[PUSCH (NR)]] remark `*2`：

- [[3GPP TS 38.214]] Section 6.1.2.2.1: “In frequency range 2, non-contiguous allocation per component carrier for UL RB allocation for CP-OFDM is not supported.”
- 來源作者因此判讀 RA0 is not really possible in [[NR FR2]]。
- 因 [[Uplink PT-RS]] mainly a FR2 feature，RA0 + PTRS combination so far had no clear focus。
- 來源同時說 this combination “looks like it is not explicitly excluded” and certain customer interest is available。

此段是來源作者判讀，不可改寫成正式 3GPP prohibition 或 permission。

PUSCH feature combination table
[[PUSCH feature combination table]] 是 [[PUSCH (NR)]] 中用來整理 PUSCH transmission features / operation modes 是否能在 one slot 內任意組合的表格；目前 raw 轉檔未保留完整 green / red matrix，因此本頁只保存可由 remarks 追溯的限制。

PUSCH feature combination table › 使用限制
- 本頁不是完整 feature combination matrix；因 raw 轉檔未保留 green / red cells，不能列出所有 pairwise combinations。
- `*2` 與 `*6` 使用來源作者推測語氣，需保留為未決判讀。
- 來源基於 [[3GPP TS 38.211]] Version 15.7.0，但引用 [[3GPP TS 38.212]] 與 [[3GPP TS 38.214]] 時未標示 version。

Uplink PT-RS › 與 time / frequency density 的關係
Uplink PT-RS 的 density derivation 在 normal OFDM case 連到 [[PTRS time and frequency density]]：

- Source cites [[3GPP TS 38.214]] Table 6.2.3.1-1 for time density derivation。
- Source cites [[3GPP TS 38.214]] Table 6.2.3.1-2 for frequency density derivation。
- PUSCH with transform precoding 的 PT-RS configuration 來源寫 will be added later；本來源未提供。

Uplink PT-RS › Single port 與 double port transmission
依 [[PT-RS (NR)]]：

- In the MIMO case, PT-RS could be sent on a single port or on two ports。
- UE signals its capability about sending PT-RS on single or double PT-RS port(s) / PUSCH layers via `onePortsPTRS` and `twoPortsPTRS`。
- Higher layer parameter `maxNrofPorts` is part of `DMRS-UplinkConfig->PTRS-UplinkConfig` and statically configures the UE for PT-RS transmission。
- If `maxNrofPorts=n1`, PT-RS will only be sent on a single port。
- If `maxNrofPorts=n2`, PT-RS is configured for double port transmission；但來源明示 even for `maxNrofPorts=n2`, PT-RS might only be transmitted on a single port。
- Single-port examples under `maxNrofPorts=n2` include single layer PUSCH allocation or PUSCH 2x2 MIMO transmission on DMRS ports 0 and 2 in codebook mode。

Uplink PT-RS › 使用限制
- [[PT-RS (NR)]] 未標示 3GPP spec versions。
- `ptrs-Power` power scaling table 未被 raw 轉檔保留。
- `maxNrofPorts=n2` 下 single-port 與 double-port 實際使用條件需回正式 [[3GPP TS 38.214]] 與 [[3GPP TS 38.212]]。

Uplink PT-RS › Power scaling
依 [[PT-RS (NR)]]：

- PTRS might be scaled up compared to the DMRS。
- Power factor depends on transmission mode and/or coherency mode、number of transmitted PUSCH layers、number of scheduled PTRS ports，以及 signaled parameter `ptrs-Power` in `PTRS-UplinkConfig`。
- 來源引用 [[3GPP TS 38.214]] chapter 6.2.3。

- 本頁不建立 RFU18 的正式產品規格；目前來源仍未提供 RFU18 order number、規格書文件編號、release date 或 supported configurations。

OFDM is a waveform in which many QAM symbols are linearly combined by an IFFT, producing signals with high peak-to-average power ratio, or PAPR [2].  
In an OFDM system, each time-domain OFDM symbol has a cyclic prefix added as a guard interval to reduce inter-symbol interference [19].  
In NR, the resource grid combines time-domain OFDM symbols with frequency-domain subcarriers, and one resource element is one subcarrier in one OFDM symbol on one antenna port [18].  
R&S CMW100 WLAN bandwidth decisions depend on OFDM because its WLAN OFDM RF analyzer bandwidths vary by standard from 5 MHz / 10 MHz / 20 MHz up to 20 MHz / 40 MHz / 80 MHz / 80+80 MHz / 160 MHz [10].  
R&S CMW100 MIMO measurement decisions depend on OFDM because WLAN OFDM MIMO options include composite MIMO R&S®CMW-KM652 and switched MIMO R&S®CMW-KM653, with WLAN OFDM RF analyzer MIMO up to 8 × 8 [10].  
R&S satellite-payload test decisions depend on OFDM because the cited R&S application context includes OFDM signal generation and analysis for custom OFDM, DFT-s-OFDM, f-OFDM, UFMC, FBMC, and GFDM [63].  
R&S SMW200A decisions depend on OFDM because the product is listed for OFDM waveform generation, multi-carrier/modulated signal generation, DPD, and NPR stimulus [49].  
R&S SMW200A bandwidth decisions depend on OFDM because the same passage lists up to 2 GHz I/Q modulation bandwidth and up to 4 GHz signal bandwidth with R&S SMW-K555 [49].  
R&S FSW-related analysis decisions depend on OFDM in this satellite-payload context because R&S FSW is listed for signal quality measurements including spurious, carrier-in-carrier, oscillator/synthesizer, group delay, linearity, NPR, and signal quality measurements, while the same source set includes OFDM among the satellite payload test concepts [49].  
R&S SMBV100B option decisions depend on OFDM because R&S®SMBVB-K811 Notched signals is supported with ARB, LTE, cellular IoT, and custom OFDM [62].  
NR measurement-configuration decisions depend on OFDM understanding because normal cyclic prefix uses 14 OFDM symbols per slot and extended cyclic prefix uses 12 OFDM symbols per slot [17].  
NR numerology decisions depend on OFDM understanding because numerology μ defines time-frequency resolution and determines OFDM symbol duration and subcarrier spacing [26].  
PTRS configuration decisions depend on OFDM understanding because the cited PT-RS density chapter applies to PDSCH and PUSCH in normal OFDM with transform precoding disabled [36].

Low-PAPR sequence › 背景：為什麼需要 low-PAPR
依 [[DMRS]]：

- OFDM signals 具有 high peak-to-average power ratio（PAPR），因為由 many random QAM symbols 的 linear combination（IFFT）形成。
- High-PAPR signal 需要 transmitter back-off power amplifier operating point，以避免 transmit signal 進入 power amplifier saturation region 而 clipped / distorted。
- Power amplifier 遠離 saturation point 操作時 efficiency drops。
- DL signals 由連接 power grid 的 base station 傳送，因此 high-PAPR 在 DL 不 critical；NR uses OFDM for DL signals。
- NR 與 LTE 不同，NR UL 也允許使用 OFDM signals。
- UL 可能需要 low-PAPR signal，使 [[UE]] power amplifier 更接近 saturation point 並提升 efficiency，降低 UE battery energy 消耗。

5G NR frame structure › OFDM symbols per slot
依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- [[Extended CP]] 使用 12 [[OFDM symbol]]s per slot。
- 來源明示在 NR Release 15 中，[[Extended CP]] only defined for numerology μ=2。

5G NR frame structure › 與 resource grid 的關係
Frame / subframe / slot / symbol 是 time-domain structure；[[NR resource grid]] 則把 time-domain [[OFDM symbol]] 與 frequency-domain subcarriers 組成 grid。

- [[Resource Element]] 是 one subcarrier in one OFDM symbol and on one antenna port。
- [[Resource Block]] 是 12 consecutive subcarriers。
- [[Point-A]] 是 resource grid starts toward higher frequencies 的 frequency-domain reference。

NR cyclic prefix › 基本概念
依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- 在 OFDM system 中，CP is added for each OFDM symbol in time-domain。
- CP 是把 raw OFDM symbol 最後幾個 samples 複製到 raw OFDM symbol 前方。
- CP provides a guard interval between two OFDM symbols。
- CP 用於 eliminate inter-symbol interference, ISI。
- NR defines two types of cyclic prefix lengths：[[Normal CP]] 與 [[Extended CP]]。

依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- Numerology μ defines the time-frequency resolution。
- μ 決定 [[OFDM symbol]] time duration 與 [[Subcarrier Spacing]]。
- NR reference SCS μ=0 是 15 kHz，來源說與 LTE 相同。
- μ 越高，time resolution 越高。
- μ 越高，frequency resolution 越低。

- R&S®SMBVB-K540 Envelope tracking：Analog I/Q outputs 可產生對應 I/Q signal envelope 的 analog signal；prerequisite 必須安裝 R&S®SMBVB-K17 option；envelope to RF delay –1 µs to +1 µs，resolution 1 ps。
- R&S®SMBVB-K541 AM/AM、AM/φM predistortion：state on/off；shaping polynomial、from table。
- R&S®SMBVB-K544 User-defined frequency response correction：scattering parameter file *.s<n>p，maximum number of points 16384，datasets cascaded up to 10；minimum compensation bandwidth 25 MHz；total compensation bandwidth standard max. 120 MHz，with extensions up to 1000 MHz。
- R&S®SMBVB-K548 Crest factor reduction：algorithm clipping and filtering；desired crest factor delta –20 dB to 0 dB。
- R&S®SMBVB-K811 Notched signals：up to 25 band-stop filters；supported with ARB、LTE、cellular IoT、custom OFDM。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 主要 RF 測試項目
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]，satellite payload / components testing 主要涵蓋：

- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：判定 transmission path phase distortions 與 channel band edges distortion。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements：gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、ACLR、[[NPR]]、distortion。
- Signal quality measurements：modulation accuracy、[[BER]]、[[EVM]]、carrier-in-carrier interference analysis。
- [[OFDM]] signal generation and analysis：custom OFDM、DFT-s-OFDM、f-OFDM、UFMC、FBMC、GFDM。
- [[Spurious emissions]] measurements：wide frequency range、very low level spurs、narrow RBW 與 long measurement time 問題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]] and gain measurements：使用 [[R&S FS-SNS]] 或 [[R&S ZNA-K30]]。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下的 payload qualification 與 calibration / power measurement。
- Digital interface testing：[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus decode / trigger / debug。
